messages.content: Could you initiate a payment request to Diego for $108?

function.name: Payment_1_RequestPayment
function.description: Initiates a payment request to a specified receiver with an optional privacy setting. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

receiver.description: The identifier for the contact or account to receive the payment request, such as an email or account number.

amount.description: The monetary value to be requested, specified in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents for USD). This is a float type value.

private_visibility.description: Indicates if the transaction should be private (true) or public (false).

function.name: Payment_1_MakePayment
function.description: Initiates a payment transaction to send money to a specified receiver using a selected payment method. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

payment_method.description: The source of funds for the payment. Choose from the available options.

amount.description: The monetary value to be sent, specified in USD. This is a float type value.

receiver.description: The identifier for the recipient, such as an account number or a contact name.

private_visibility.description: Determines if the transaction will be visible to others or kept private.
